title: AIDD Domain Map
description: Configuration for aidd-domain-guard.cjs — defines DDD layers and import rules

layers.description: Map of layer name → array of glob patterns that belong to this layer

rules.description: Import restriction rules. Each rule declares what a layer cannot import from.

from.description: Source layer name (must exist in layers)

cannot_import_from.description: Target layer names that are forbidden

exception_via.description: If import target matches this layer, the rule is satisfied (DI via port)

frontend_business_suppress.description: Glob patterns exempt from Frontend_Business_Guard checks
